name: Dragon's Roar
main_effect:
When this card is trashed from the security stack, activate its [Security] effects.
While you have a yellow [Data] or [Witchelny] trait Digimon, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] By trashing your top security card, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -6000 DP until the end of their turn. Then, if you have 2 or fewer security cards, place this card as your bottom security card.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less. Then, if you have 0 security cards, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞ (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
